items.title: Is a Beat in Store for Intercontinental Exchange This Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: ICE's Q2 results are likely to benefit from strength in data services, exchange trading and mortgage technology despite higher expenses.

items.title: Tradr Launches Two Leveraged ETFs on SK hynix
items.summary: Tradr ETFs, a provider of ETFs designed for sophisticated investors and professional traders, today launched two single-stock leveraged ETFs with long and short exposure to SK hynix Inc.'s U.S-listed shares (Nasdaq: SKHY).  The funds, listed on Cboe, seek to deliver 200% and -200% of the daily performance of the South Korean semiconductor and memory chip maker.

items.title: S&P Global (SPGI) Beats Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: S&P Global (SPGI) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +7.57% and +0.84%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Zacks Industry Outlook Highlights CME Group, Intercontinental Exchange, Nasdaq and Cboe Global Markets
items.summary: CME, ICE, NDAQ and CBOE could benefit from rising trading activity, recurring revenues and technology investments despite industry competition.

items.title: 4 Securities & Exchanges Stocks to Watch Despite Intense Competition
items.summary: Zacks Securities and Exchanges industry players like CME, ICE, NDAQ and CBOE gain from rising crypto adoption, a higher non-trading revenue base and tech investments. However, competition remains a drag.

items.title: Why XDTE’s $12.65 annual payout might be half what it seems
items.summary: XDTE's weekly payouts and 30-plus percent trailing yield look like an income investor's dream, but two payments buried in 2025 year-end data may be doing far more heavy lifting than most buyers realize.

items.title: Retirees Can Now Get 100 Percent Downside Protection in an ETF and Still Keep Stock Market Upside
items.summary: Structured notes have long offered this kind of downside protection, but retirees had to lock up capital and accept illiquidity to get it. A new breed of ETF changes that equation in a way most conservative investors have not yet considered.

items.title: Bitcoin’s 40% Decline Reveals Why BTCI’s 15% Yield May Not Last
items.summary: BTCI promises monthly income from Bitcoin's chaos, but the mechanics behind its headline yield tell a story most investors never read before buying in.
